passages.title: Choosing a Speaker
text: G: Jinho, look! These two speakers look pretty cool.
B: Yeah, they do. Which do you prefer, the red one or the black one?
G: I prefer the red one to the black one. It’s only 20 dollars, and it comes with a discount coupon for music downloads.
B: Although the black one is 40 dollars, I think it’s the right one for me. I heard it has better sound quality
